title: Buffalo, NY Weather Alert: 1-2 Inches Of Lake Effect Snow Along I-90, Route 219 Through Thursday Morning - NewsBreak
text:
By County Herald Weather Center ,
10 hours ago Country Herald is Local News, Independent Pulse. Covering breaking local news, sports, lifestyle and events. Buffalo, New York – Drivers across Western New York should remain alert through Thursday morning as bands of lake effect snow continue to impact areas south of Lake Ontario, bringing light accumulations and periodic reductions in visibility along major travel routes including I-90 and I-190.
